title: Act 4: Echos of the Past
changeNote:
## 1.3.0 Changes

- Corrupted Players now appear in a separate Elite fight between the Shop and the Architect, only when saved opponents exist. Winning grants normal Elite rewards and returns to the map before a fresh Architect combat.
- Increased Corrupted Player HP to 2.5 times saved maximum HP at Ascension 0-7 and 3.1 times at Ascension 8+, rounded up with no additional multiplayer scaling.
- Losing the Corrupted Player Elite now shows the normal game-over screen and preserves the previous saved opponents. Only wins or losses against the Architect boss capture player decks and play the corruption ending.
- Fixed Act 4 map icons losing their interior details. Shop and campfire icons now retain light and dark contrast instead of appearing as solid silhouettes.
- Updated the Watcher's map portrait and hover outline.
- Clarified empty and unavailable Corrupted Deck preview messages.
- Replaced the Architect soundtrack with RYS's "The Heart OST but it's Metal". Each boss fight starts at the intro and loops during combat.
- Corrupted Players use their own section of the soundtrack. After victory, the track plays through its ending once, continuing across rewards and the map.
- Restored the game's run-ending music after the Architect's final strike, without changing the recorded win or loss.
